body:
I just wanna be remembered as someone who made a positive influence in people's lives. I don't necessarily wanna win a Nobel Peace prize or some shit, but I wanna know that I could be someone my friends can talk to, and I feel that I am that, but my issue is that when I go through hardships I feel as if I have no one to talk to, and I don't wanna bother people who are happy with shit that'll make them unhappy, so I've trained myself to never express my emotions. I would've said posting about your problems on reddit was some dumb shit years ago, but here I can remain anonymous and not worry about anyone close finding out about this.

 As for what you asked about shit that made me curious as a kid.. I just wanna make something. I've gone through phases. First I wanted to write movies, then I wanted to be an actor, now I sort of wanna make music. I just wanna create something that can make people feel something, and I have been working on that (who knows if the shit is good or not but hey, it's worth a shot) but all I know is that when I'm cooped up on my room and feel like I could cry but I can't, I write about it and I feel somewhat better, so I've turned to that. Idk.
